title: The Moon Unbent
summary: The Old Fears are slain, the offer refused, and the moon climbs back into the sky.

epilogue.title: The Moon Returned
epilogue.text: The moon is back in the sky, plain and pale, and without a face. Fishermen who never saw it before say it is the loveliest thing in the dark.

epilogue.title: The Old Fears
epilogue.text: All eight of the Old Fears are gone from their regions. Each place they held has begun, shyly, to be a place again.
